name: Treehouse Serenity Dome
feature: A suspended king bed beneath the trees
description: Wake up among the branches, then take your coffee down to the suspended king bed below the deck. A soaking tub inside and a cowboy pool outside give you two very different ways to spend an afternoon.

name: Lunar Dome
feature: An outdoor shower among the treetops
description: Follow the deck to a suspended outdoor shower tucked into the trees. Back inside, a king bed and a deep soaking tub sit under the dome’s curved roof.

name: Cloud Dome
feature: A hammock bed on a wooded bluff
description: Settle into a hammock bed at the edge of a wooded bluff. The outdoor shower and private hot tub bring the best parts of the day out into the trees.

name: Cherry Cove
description: Trade the hammock chairs for a dip in the cowboy pool, then draw the tent closed for a movie on the projector. A king bed and en-suite shower make it easy to settle in.

name: Oak Retreat
feature: A king bed and movies under canvas
description: Pull up a hammock chair and let the afternoon pass. Come evening, the canvas walls frame a king bed and a projector for a private movie night.

name: Pecan Haven
feature: A canvas treehouse ten feet up
description: Climb up to a canvas tent raised about ten feet above the ground. Start the day in the outdoor shower, or stretch out in a hammock chair and watch the trees.

name: Walnut Horizon
feature: An observation deck above a tiny home
description: Bring supper up to the observation deck. With a full kitchen, a soaking tub and a sofa that opens into a California king bed, this little house has room for four.

name: Cozy Tiny Home
feature: A reading loft and a private pool deck
description: Bring a book for the reading loft and a towel for the cowboy pool. A fenced deck gives you space outdoors, while the king bed sits up in the loft.

name: Das Grun Haus
feature: A backyard made for fireside evenings
description: Also known as the Green House, this two-bedroom cottage sits on a shared ten-acre property. Set up a yard game, light the charcoal grill and gather around the fire pit after dinner.

name: The Hidden Tavern
feature: A secret passage to a private speakeasy
description: On more than ten acres, this five-bedroom house gives a group room to spread out. There’s an upstairs bunkroom, a pair of hot tubs and a speakeasy hidden beyond a secret passage.
